name: The Raven
source:
After a stressful week, you, a dispassionate college student become attracted to a stranger met at a Halloween party, only for this encounter to become deadly. Will you survive the night?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250726120150/https://st-chem-atelier.itch.io/theraven-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
经过紧张的一周后，你，一个冷静的大学生，被万圣节派对上遇到的一个陌生人所吸引，结果这次遭遇变得致命。你能活过这个夜晚吗？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250726120150/https://st-chem-atelier.itch.io/theraven-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
